# S432 — Accept slicer relay contract v13 (engine runs the finish step)

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

slicer s460 bumps RELAY_CONTRACT from 12 to 13. The v13 rule: when the orchestrator is a program, it may run the closing note and the finish step itself after VERDICT: PASS, using the note text from the Outcome: line in the implementer's last report; the implementer writes Outcome: and runs neither command. When the orchestrator is an agent, the implementer still runs both steps. Order, report shape and gate are unchanged. slicer ai relay --json carries the rule in its obligations. This puts ork adj 407 (engine.finish-runner) into the contract. Today ork accepts only v11/v12 (ork projects pin help), and slicer on PATH is the slicer main checkout, so landing s460 before ork accepts v13 would break every ork project's relays, as s453 (v12) did on 2026-11-12. s460 runs with --stop-after commit (run ork-20261118-130321-4cea) and lands only after this item: accept v13 in the contract check, doctor and pins, and run the finish step in the engine from the Outcome: line.

Evidence (2026-11-18):

- ork's accepted set is `acceptedContracts = []int{11, 12}` (`internal/roles/roles.go:113-116`, adj 326 `boundary.contract-set`), and `CheckContractLine` refuses any other version (`internal/roles/roles.go:131-144`). The engine, `ork doctor` and `ork projects pin --relay N` all go through it (`internal/slicercli/contract.go:75-80`, `internal/cli/doctor.go:252,294`, `internal/cli/pin.go:67`).
- The s460 branch (slicer `6cfb5c18`) sets `RELAY_CONTRACT = 13` (`slicer/src/slicer/ai.py:259` on that branch), adds the `RELAY_CHANGES` entry for 13, and adds the Conformance obligation `finish_runner` after `finish_after_pass`. The rule says a program orchestrator "may" run both steps; the implementer runs neither only when the program does run them. So an ork that accepts v13 and still resumes the implementer for the finish step (`internal/engine/states.go:1308-1340`) is conformant.
- `slicer ai relay --json` from the s460 branch prints `"contract": "relay v13"` and the `finish_runner` conformance entry (read-only run on 2026-11-18 with `PYTHONPATH` set to the s460 worktree's `src`).
- Validate requires a fixed list of conformance keys (`internal/slicercli/contract.go:91`) and v12's `tool_feedback` key from v12 on (`internal/slicercli/contract.go:110-113`).

Open owner questions:

- Which versions ork accepts once slicer prints v13, and whether the role prompts move to v13. adj 326 (v11-v12, decided 2026-11-12) settles only v11 and v12; the rule it followed (adj 175 and 326) was the current version and one back. Per the owner's answer to `boundary.contract-set` (a new record that supersedes adj 326).
- Whether this slice also runs the finish step in the engine. S384 (Finish step without a model round, specced, waits on v13) already covers that: `TestFinishRunsSlicerWithoutARole`, `TestFinishUsesTheOutcomeLine` and the v13 report shape. This spec covers only accepting v13 and leaves the engine's finish step to S384, per the owner's answer to `scope.v13-finish-slice`.
